Convert a SingleCellExperiment or Seurat Object to an exposomicset

Source: R/transform_sce_to_exposomicset.R
transform_sce_to_exposomicset.Rd

Pseudo-bulk aggregates a SingleCellExperiment or Seurat object to the donor level, splitting by cell type so that each cell type becomes a separate named experiment in the returned MultiAssayExperiment. Donor-level metadata is extracted directly from colData(sce).

Usage

transform_sce_to_exposomicset(
  sce,
  codebook,
  sample_col = "sample",
  cluster_col = "label",
  sample_meta_cols = NULL,
  assay_name = "counts",
  min_cells_per_donor = 10,
  min_donor_frac = 0.8
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment or Seurat object with at least one assay and cell-level metadata columns matching sample_col and cluster_col.

codebook

A data frame with columns variable and category describing the donor-level metadata columns selected via sample_meta_cols.

sample_col

Character. Column in colData(sce) identifying the donor or sample each cell belongs to. Default "sample".

cluster_col

Character. Column in colData(sce) identifying cell type or cluster labels. Each unique value becomes a separate experiment in the MAE. Default "label".

sample_meta_cols

Character vector of column names in colData(sce) to retain as donor-level metadata. These should be donor-level variables (e.g. age, sex, smoking status) rather than cell-level variables (e.g. n_genes_detected). The function deduplicates to one row per donor after selecting these columns. If NULL, only sample_col is used and colData will be minimal.

assay_name

Character. Assay to aggregate. Default "counts".

min_cells_per_donor

Integer. Minimum number of cells a donor must contribute to a given cell type to be included in that cell type's pseudo-bulk matrix. Donors below this are dropped from that experiment only. Default 10.

min_donor_frac

Numeric between 0 and 1. Minimum fraction of donors that must pass min_cells_per_donor for a cell type to be retained as an experiment. Cell types below this threshold are dropped with a warning. Default 0.8.

Value

A MultiAssayExperiment exposomicset with one pseudo-bulk experiment per retained cell type, ready for tidyexposomics functions.

Details

Pseudo-bulk aggregation sums raw counts across all cells belonging to the same donor and cell type.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
mae <- transform_sce_to_exposomicset(
    sce              = sce,
    codebook         = my_codebook,
    sample_col       = "donor_id",
    cluster_col      = "cell_type",
    sample_meta_cols = c("age", "sex", "smoking_status", "BMI")
)

mae <- mae |>
    run_exposure_omics_association(
        exposures  = c("pm25", "no2"),
        covariates = c("age", "sex")
    )
} # }
